```{r}
library(ipumsr)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

set_ipums_api_key("59cba10d8a5da536fc06b59de0685e90a88146488981f64a8691b023", save = TRUE, overwrite=TRUE)
 
# ---- Parameters -------------------------------
state_fips   <- c(CA = "06", OR = "41", WA = "53")
shapefile_id <- "us_blck_grp_2020_tl2020"   # 2020 block groups (TIGER/Line-based)
download_dir <- "data"
out_file     <- file.path(download_dir, "block_groups_ca_or_wa.gpkg")

```

```{r}
extract <- define_extract_agg(
  collection  = "nhgis",
  description = "Block groups for CA, OR, WA (2020)",
  shapefiles  = shapefile_id
)


submitted <- submit_extract(extract)
ready <- wait_for_extract(submitted)
zip_path <- download_extract(ready, download_dir = download_dir, overwrite = TRUE)

bg <- read_ipums_sf(zip_path)
```
